transformation: Generated by tools/rebuild_pbase_inventories.py from pbase/ipa2allfeatures.csv in the archive: the columns prefixed HC. (Halle and Clements), in upstream order, one row per transcription (a transcription listed twice is kept once, a disagreeing cell becoming ?). Cells: + and - unchanged; x -> + and o -> - (the UFT node is present or absent, a contrast); n -> 0 (the feature does not apply, as PHOIBLE's 0); . -> ? (no value given). It replaces a manual extraction from the P-base website made in 2019, which agreed with this table on 44,741 of 44,748 cells of the segments both list, but read x, o and n as a midpoint value.
citation: Mielke, Jeff. P-base. North Carolina State University. https://pbase.phon.chass.ncsu.edu/. See also Mielke, Jeff. 2008. The Emergence of Distinctive Features. Oxford: Oxford University Press.
